   138	#[test]
   139	#[ignore = "requires frozen 0.4.28 binary via SNAPBACK4_BASELINE_BIN"]
   140	fn a_0_4_28_store_rebuilds_legacy_aggregate_ids_and_fences_old_devices() {
   141	    let baseline = PathBuf::from(
   142	        std::env::var_os("SNAPBACK4_BASELINE_BIN")
   143	            .expect("set SNAPBACK4_BASELINE_BIN to the frozen 0.4.28 snapback4 binary"),
   144	    );
   145	    assert!(
   146	        baseline.is_file(),
   147	        "SNAPBACK4_BASELINE_BIN is not a file: {}",
   148	        baseline.display()
   149	    );
   150	    let version = Command::new(&baseline).arg("--version").output().unwrap();
   151	    assert!(version.status.success());
   152	    assert!(
   153	        String::from_utf8_lossy(&version.stdout).contains("0.4.28"),
   154	        "unexpected baseline: {:?}",
   155	        version
   156	    );
   157	
   158	    let dir = Temp::new(BASELINE_SOURCE);
   159	    let group_id = "g";
   160	    let created = Command::new(&baseline)
   161	        .current_dir(&dir.0)
   162	        .args([
   163	            "run",
   164	            "createGroup",
   165	            &serde_json::json!({"id": group_id, "owner": "alice"}).to_string(),
   166	            "--as",
   167	            "alice",
   168	            "--now",
   169	            "1",
   170	            "--json",
   171	        ])
   172	        .output()
   173	        .unwrap();
   174	    assert!(created.status.success(), "{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&created.stderr));
   175	    let group = "x".repeat(200);
   176	    let args = serde_json::json!({"group": group, "ownerGroup": group_id, "amount": 7}).to_string();
   177	    let written = Command::new(&baseline)
   178	        .current_dir(&dir.0)
   179	        .args(["run", "add", &args, "--as", "alice", "--now", "1", "--json"])
   180	        .output()
   181	        .unwrap();
   182	    assert!(
   183	        written.status.success(),
   184	        "{}",
   185	        String::from_utf8_lossy(&written.stderr)
   186	    );
   187	    let store = dir.0.join(".snapback4/store.sqlite");
   188	    let legacy = aggregate_id(&store);
   189	    assert!(
   190	        !snapback4_core::value::identity_fits(&legacy),
   191	        "the frozen binary must have written the oversized legacy address"
   192	    );
   193	    let small_group = "small";
   194	    let legacy_small = snapback4_core::value::canonical_json(&[
   195	        snapback4_core::Value::String(small_group.into()),
   196	    ]);
   197	    let legacy_pointer_total = snapback4_core::value::canonical_json(&[
   198	        snapback4_core::Value::Id(legacy_small.clone()),
   199	    ]);
   200	    for (operation, args) in [
   201	        ("add", serde_json::json!({"group": small_group, "ownerGroup": group_id, "amount": 3})),
   202	        ("point", serde_json::json!({"total": legacy_small})),
   203	        ("save", serde_json::json!({"target": legacy_pointer_total})),
   204	    ] {
   205	        let output = Command::new(&baseline).current_dir(&dir.0)
   206	            .args(["run", operation, &args.to_string(), "--as", "alice", "--now", "1", "--json"])
   207	            .output().unwrap();
   208	        assert!(output.status.success(), "{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));
   209	    }
   210	    let before: u64 = Connection::open(&store)
   211	        .unwrap()
   212	        .query_row(
   213	            "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='generation'",
   214	            [],
   215	            |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
   216	        )
   217	        .unwrap()
   218	        .parse()
   219	        .unwrap();
   220	
   221	    // Adding this path records ownerGroup.owner on entries. Adoption must
   222	    // capture it without rebuilding totals before the legacy id maps have
   223	    // translated pointers and saved.
   224	    fs::write(dir.0.join("snapback/schema.q"), SOURCE).unwrap();
   225	
   226	    let opened = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_snapback4"))
   227	        .current_dir(&dir.0)
   228	        .args([
   229	            "run",
   230	            "total",
   231	            &serde_json::json!({"group": group}).to_string(),
   232	            "--as",
   233	            "alice",
   234	            "--now",
   235	            "2",
   236	            "--json",
   237	        ])
   238	        .output()
   239	        .unwrap();
   240	    assert!(
   241	        opened.status.success(),
   242	        "stdout={} stderr={}",
   243	        String::from_utf8_lossy(&opened.stdout),
   244	        String::from_utf8_lossy(&opened.stderr)
   245	    );
   246	    let answer: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&opened.stdout).unwrap();
   247	    assert_eq!(answer["data"], 7, "{answer}");
   248	
   249	    let digest = aggregate_id(&store);
   250	    assert_eq!(digest.len(), 64);
   251	    assert_ne!(digest, legacy);
   252	    let conn = Connection::open(&store).unwrap();
   253	    let (after, marker): (u64, String) = (
   254	        conn.query_row(
   255	            "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='generation'",
   256	            [],
   257	            |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
   258	        )
   259	        .unwrap()
   260	        .parse()
   261	        .unwrap(),
   262	        conn.query_row(
   263	            "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key=?1",
   264	            [snapback4_core::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META],
   265	            |row| row.get(0),
   266	        )
   267	        .unwrap(),
   268	    );
   269	    assert!(
   270	        after > before,
   271	        "identity adoption must publish a new device generation"
   272	    );
   273	    assert_eq!(marker, snapback4_core::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION);
   274	    let small_digest = snapback4_core::schema::maintained_id(&[snapback4_core::Value::String(small_group.into())]);
   275	    let pointer: String = conn.query_row(
   276	        "SELECT r.data FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=r.t WHERE c.name='pointers'",
   277	        [], |row| row.get(0),
   278	    ).unwrap();
   279	    let pointer: snapback4_core::Value = serde_json::from_str(&pointer).unwrap();
   280	    assert_eq!(pointer.field("total").unwrap(), &snapback4_core::Value::Id(small_digest.clone()), "adoption rewrites surviving references before replacing their aggregate targets");
   281	    let pointer_total_digest = snapback4_core::schema::maintained_id(&[
   282	        snapback4_core::Value::Id(small_digest),
   283	    ]);
   284	    let saved: String = conn.query_row(
   285	        "SELECT r.data FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=r.t WHERE c.name='saved'",
   286	        [], |row| row.get(0),
   287	    ).unwrap();
   288	    let saved: snapback4_core::Value = serde_json::from_str(&saved).unwrap();
   289	    assert_eq!(saved.field("target").unwrap(), &snapback4_core::Value::Id(pointer_total_digest.clone()), "adoption resolves aggregate-reference dependencies before rewriting transitive references");
   290	    let count: i64 = conn.query_row(
   291	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=r.t WHERE c.name='pointerTotals' AND r.id=?1",
   292	        [&pointer_total_digest], |row| row.get(0),
   293	    ).unwrap();
   294	    assert_eq!(count, 1, "the transitive reference must address the rebuilt aggregate row");
   295	
   296	    let bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(), SOURCE.into())]);
   297	    assert!(bound.diagnostics.is_empty(), "{:?}", bound.diagnostics);
   298	    let required =
   299	        snapback4_core::device_protocol::compatibility(&bound.schema.public_projection());
   300	    assert!(
   301	        required
   302	            .capabilities
   303	            .contains(&"maintained-id-sha256-v1".to_owned())
   304	    );
   305	    let mut old = snapback4_core::device_protocol::DeviceEngine::current();
   306	    old.version = "0.4.28".into();
   307	    old.capabilities
   308	        .retain(|capability| capability != "maintained-id-sha256-v1");
   309	    let refusal = snapback4_core::device_protocol::check(Some(&old), &required).unwrap_err();
   310	    assert_eq!(refusal.code, "E_DEVICE_VERSION");
   311	    assert!(
   312	        refusal.message.contains("maintained-id-sha256-v1"),
   313	        "{refusal:?}"
   314	    );
   315	}

     1	//! Internal contribution format adoption under the evaluation adapter's writer lock.
     2	use super::store::Tx;
     3	use crate::{error::{MeterKind, RuntimeError}, meter::{Ceilings, Cut, Meter}, rows::{adoption, word_heap as heap}, schema::{IndexComponent, Schema, Table}, value::{Value, canonical_json}};
     4	
     5	pub(super) fn install(tx: &Tx<'_>, schema: &mut Schema) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
     6	    let backend = tx.query("SELECT schema,generation FROM _backend WHERE singleton", &[])?;
     7	    let previous: Schema = super::store::decode(backend[0].get(0))?;
     8	    let mut generation = backend[0].get::<_, i64>(1);
     9	    schema.prepare_contribution_indexes();
    10	    if *schema != previous {
    11	        for (name, table) in &schema.tables {
    12	            for (index_name, index) in &table.indexes {
    13	                let Some(IndexComponent::Contribution(maintain)) = index.components.first() else {continue};
    14	                if previous.table(name).and_then(|t|t.index(index_name)) == Some(index) {continue;}
    15	                tx.execute("DELETE FROM i WHERE t = $1 AND ix = $2", &[name,index_name])?;
    16	                let work=adoption::Work::DECODE.with_contribution(maintain);
    17	                let mut after: Option<String> = None;
    18	                loop {
    19	                    let mut meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);
    20	                    meter.at(&format!("adopt {name}.{index_name}"));
    21	                    meter.heap(4096 + after.as_deref().map_or(0, heap::text))?;
    22	                    let page=source_page(&tx,name,table,after.as_deref(),&mut meter,work)?;
    23	                    if page.is_empty() { break; }
    24	                    for raw in &page {
    25	                        let scratch=meter.mark();
    26	                        let id=raw.get::<_,&str>(0);
    27	                        let data=raw.get::<_,&str>(1);
    28	                        meter.charge(MeterKind::Examined,1)?;
    29	                        adoption::charge(&mut meter, adoption::decode_bytes(data))?;
    30	                        let row: Value=super::store::decode(data)?;
    31	                        meter.charge(MeterKind::Examined,1)?;
    32	                        meter.step(maintain.evaluation_steps())?;
    33	                        adoption::charge(&mut meter, adoption::contribution_bytes(&row,table))?;
    34	                        for key in crate::rows::stored_index_keys(table,index,&row,id) {
    35	                            if key.len() > crate::rows::MAX_INDEX_KEY_BYTES { return Err(crate::rows::index_key_refusal(name,index_name,1)); }
    36	                            meter.charge(MeterKind::IndexEntries,1)?;
    37	                            tx.execute("INSERT INTO i(t,ix,k,id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)", &[name,index_name,&key,&id])?;
    38	                        }
    39	                        drop(row);
    40	                        meter.release_heap(scratch);
    41	                    }
    42	                    let last=page.last().expect("nonempty page").get::<_,&str>(0);
    43	                    meter.heap(heap::text(last))?;
    44	                    after=Some(last.to_owned());
    45	                    // The full driver-owned page remains reserved until every
    46	                    // decoded row and its index scratch have been consumed.
    47	                    drop(page);
    48	                }
    49	            }
    50	        }
    51	        generation=generation.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(||RuntimeError::Generation("generation overflow".into()))?;
    52	        tx.execute("UPDATE _backend SET schema = $1, generation = $2 WHERE singleton", &[&canonical_json(schema), &generation])?;
    53	    }
    54	    u64::try_from(generation).map_err(|_|RuntimeError::Generation("negative generation".into()))
    55	}

    57	// @ref LLP 3000.007#20.9.3 — adoption reserves fetched images separately from per-row contribution scratch.
    58	pub(super) fn source_page(tx: &super::store::Tx<'_>, table: &str, schema: &Table, after: Option<&str>, meter: &mut Meter, work: adoption::Work) -> Result<Vec<postgres::Row>, RuntimeError> {
    59	    let sizes=if after.is_some() {
    60	        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(octet_length(id) + octet_length(data)),0)::bigint, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id,data FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND id>$2 ORDER BY id LIMIT $3) AS picked"
    61	    } else {
    62	        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(octet_length(id) + octet_length(data)),0)::bigint, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id,data FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND $2::text IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT $3) AS picked"
    63	    };
    64	    let mut limit=32i64;
    65	    let page_mark=meter.mark();
    66	    loop {
    67	        limit=work.limit(meter,limit as usize) as i64;
    68	        let size=tx.query(sizes,&[&table,&after,&limit])?;
    69	        let bytes=size[0].get::<_,i64>(0) as u64;
    70	        let count=size[0].get::<_,i64>(1) as u64;
    71	        // Network/read buffers, retained driver rows and their metadata. Typed
    72	        // JSON decode is priced from borrowed text later, one row at a time;
    73	        // the query scan's conservative 256x all-rows decoder is inappropriate
    74	        // for this walk. This initial estimate is followed by a scratch check
    75	        // before any adoption callback runs.
    76	        let reservation=bytes.saturating_mul(8).saturating_add(count.saturating_mul(1024));
    77	        if limit>1 && reservation>meter.ceilings.heap_bytes/2 { limit/=2; continue; }
    78	        meter.heap(reservation)?;
    79	        let query=if after.is_some() {
    80	            "SELECT id,data FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND id>$2 ORDER BY id LIMIT $3"
    81	        } else {
    82	            "SELECT id,data FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND $2::text IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT $3"
    83	        };
    84	        let page=tx.query(query,&[&table,&after,&limit])?;
    85	        if adoption::page_fits(page.iter().map(|raw| raw.get::<_,&str>(1)), meter, work,
    86	            Some(&|row| adoption::contribution_bytes(row,schema)))? { return Ok(page); }
    87	        limit=(page.len() as i64/2).max(1);
    88	        drop(page);
    89	        meter.release_heap(page_mark.clone());
    90	    }
    91	}

   108	    pub fn adopt_at(
   109	        &mut self,
   110	        mut schema: Schema,
   111	        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
   112	        now: i64,
   113	    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
   114	        schema.prepare_contribution_indexes();
   115	        // @ref LLP 3000.022#5 — adoption replaces tracked membership and any shared binding index.
   116	        schema.prepare_delivery_lookup();
   117	        let programs: BTreeMap<_, _> = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
   118	        supported(&schema, &programs)?;
   119	        let generation = self
   120	            .generation()
   121	            .checked_add(1)
   122	            .ok_or_else(|| RuntimeError::Generation("generation overflow".into()))?;
   123	        let tx = self.store.transaction(Some(WriteMode::Serialized))?;
   124	        let shortened =
   125	            super::super::through_activation::activate(&tx, &schema, Some(&self.schema), now)?;
   126	        tx.execute("DELETE FROM i", &[])?;
   127	        tx.execute("DELETE FROM _cap_counts", &[])?;
   128	        for name in self
   129	            .schema
   130	            .tables
   131	            .keys()
   132	            .filter(|n| !schema.tables.contains_key(*n))
   133	        {
   134	            tx.execute("DELETE FROM r WHERE t=$1", &[name])?;
   135	        }
   136	        for (name, table) in &schema.tables {
   137	            let mut after = String::new();
   138	            loop {
   139	                let page = tx.query(
   140	                    "SELECT id,data FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND id>$2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 256",
   141	                    &[name, &after],
   142	                )?;
   143	                if page.is_empty() {
   144	                    break;
   145	                }
   146	                for item in page {
   147	                    after = item.get(0);
   148	                    let mut row: Value = decode(item.get(1))?;
   149	                    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut row {
   150	                        fields.retain(|f, _| table.columns.contains_key(f));
   151	                    }
   152	                    table.recompute_deadline(&mut row)?;
   153	                    validate::validate_row(&schema, name, &crate::schema::row_image(&row, table))?;
   154	                    tx.execute("DELETE FROM r WHERE t=$1 AND id=$2", &[name, &after])?;
   155	                    tx.put(name, table, &row, None)?;
   156	                }
   157	            }
   158	        }
   159	        let seq = tx.next_seq()?;
   160	        let mut runner = Runner::new(
   161	            &tx,
   162	            &schema,
   163	            Context::system().at(now),
   164	            Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort),
   165	            seq,

I found a formal/runtime mismatch across consecutive sweeps. The runtime retains its table continuation after a complete sweep, while Lean restarts in reverse lexical order. With cascade, restrict, and set-null references, that can change the next sweep’s committed state. I’m checking the exact counterexample and line references.

- **The formal sweep ignores persisted table continuation.** [Write.lean:308](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-w12-lang/snapback4/lean/Quarry/Write.lean:308) always starts in reverse lexical order, whereas [through_activation.rs:24](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-w12-lang/snapback4/crates/snapback4-core/src/engine/through_activation.rs:24) rotates subsequent runtime sweeps after the last visited table, including after complete sweeps. The [differential harness:387](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-w12-lang/snapback4/crates/snapback4-difftest/src/lean.rs:387) carries only the formal store forward.

  Extend `sweepRetirementOrderStore` with an unreferenced `zRoots[q]` expiring at 5; keep `a` and `z` expiring at 10. Sweep at 5, then at 10 on the same engine. The first sweep deletes `q`, retaining the `zRoots` table continuation. Runtime’s second sweep therefore visits `aRoots` first, cascades the shared blocker, then deletes `z` and clears its nullable reference. Lean visits `zRoots` first, retains restricted `z`, and leaves that reference unchanged. This produces observably different committed state within the supported fragment. The formal model and harness need to preserve sweep continuation and cover consecutive sweeps.
